risks.risk: The engine may be a generic or used part rather than a genuine Hyundai part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or base).

risks.risk: The starter motor may be faulty or have a weak battery.
risks.proof: A video of the starter motor being tested to hear it engage and crank the engine.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal mechanical damage or high compression.
risks.proof: A compression test report or a video of the engine running.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the starter motor being tested.
Photo of the engine's intake manifold or fuel rail to confirm the specific Hyundai model.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
